# Ledger — Cloud Cost Optimization

- **Goal / definition of done:** reduce cloud infrastructure spend by 25% (run-rate) without
  hurting reliability, by **2026-12-31**.
- **Owner:** [Grace Liu](../people/grace-liu.md) (technical), sponsored by
  [Marcus Feld](../people/marcus-feld.md) (CFO).
- **Status:** **on track** but early; the June bill spiked and Marcus wants a written explanation.
- **Levers:** rightsizing, spot capacity, storage tiering, and killing idle non-prod clusters.

## Open items
- June overage write-up owed to Marcus.
- Careful sequencing against [Meridian](meridian.md) — do not trade reliability for cost.
